mode: research only; never read questions, community forecasts, private inputs or transactions
population: First Monday of each calendar month, 2018-01 through 2024-12 at 12:00 UTC. Independent targets: credit ICE BofA US HY OAS at end of 5 and 10 weekdays, and Cboe VIX maximum intraday high over those horizons. Exclude origin day from feature observations. Use last actual ALFRED observation as of Saturday before spot and first publication snapshot in experiment (next month's vintage) for resolution; allow end level up to one trading day stale. VIX prices truncated before origin; vendor history may include corrections.
comparison: Existing Q4 credit statistical forecasting component, frozen width 1.25. VIX comparator only shadow width 1.0 of preexisting VIX numerical component. Both take the existing five quantiles; all models share the same custom proper binned log score, not Metaculus points. Q4/Q3 labels, CP, sports, and competition questions not used.
primary: Credit only: heldout mean per-origin difference in natural-log mass (5- and 10-day targets averaged within origin) vs frozen statistical component. Study three challengers C/F/G. VIX results reported separately as exploratory with unapproved shadow comparator. Equal date weighting, all paired completions, audit omitted date/series.
C: Base-rate dispersion calibration: one multiplier per family maximizing development mean log mass with (0.75,1,1.25,1.5,2); tie-break toward 1. At least 18 development months needed, otherwise abstain from fitting and retain width 1.
G: Economic statistical forecast: distribution of observed same-horizon point-in-time changes or future high multiples. Mix equally the most recent 126 historical starts and up to 505 available starts. Credit retains directional history, VIX uses empirical high/current-close ratio. No fit on test.
F: Route by series (ending level vs maximum) and horizon. On development select G over the frozen comparison only when mean log-mass gain exceeds 0.02 nats and at least 18 development months exist for this class. Otherwise retain comparison. Decision frozen for future holdout.
bins: 50 equally spaced OAS bins over [0,25] percentage points, and 120 VIX bins over [0,120], with separate lower and upper tails. Piecewise-linear CDF between five quantiles, exponential tails with boundary-matched slope, mixed with 1% uniform over all bins for a common resolution floor.
splits: Development: 2018-01 through 2020-12. Held out: 2021-01 through 2024-12. Resolve and score after freezing all model definitions. Historical holdout, not live.
statistics: Predeclared primary family Holm FWER correction over the three one-sided model-vs-comparison tests. One sample per calendar quarter containing all paired origins; quarter-block sign permutation and 95% percentile bootstrap of quarter means, seed 77411, 8192 draws. Effect point estimate is equal month average; report both estimands if missing dates. Evidence needs >=12 complete holdout quarters, adjusted p<0.05, lower 95% interval>0, positive in both two-year halves; no promotion regardless of archived results alone.
reproducibility: No substitute of today's vintage for a missing historical FRED file; run CBOE cohort independently if ALFRED absent. Save URLs and SHA256 hashes before scoring.
